semantic_comparators.input: file version, task_progress/started/completed/repeatable long maps, completion_count integers, claimed_rewards map and player_data UUID map
semantic_comparators.output: version mismatch marksDirty; maps reconstructed via persistent string-ID resolver; per-player data imported with UUID parse exception logged and skipped for malformed key
semantic_comparators.preservation: separately retains started/completed/claimed/repeat cooldown data; one bad UUID doesn't abort all other per-player records; does not turn progress into rewards here
semantic_comparators.application_limit: map.clear happens before restore; unknown IDs resolve through file.getID, further resolver policy must be traced. Same helper with long/int difference not extra credits.1.21 near-identical version needs dedup

semantic_comparators.input: item payload, count long, consumption/crafting/NBT tristates and screen flags
semantic_comparators.output: restores item and count clamp>=1; restores explicit/inherited policy flags
semantic_comparators.preservation: Writer omits count when1; loader clamp maps omitted0 back1. submitItemsOnInventoryChange depends on consumesResources, so configuration restore affects actual item/progress ownership.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: Definition count is required quantity, not player completed amount. Do not map old dq progress into this definition field or grant item/reward on load.

semantic_comparators.input: saved target long value and points-vs-levels boolean; existing team task progress, player current XP
semantic_comparators.output: reader restores authored unit policy; submission computes min available/outstanding/intmax, debits exact points or levels then adds earned team progress
semantic_comparators.preservation: Concrete paid XP objective state and consumer, separate from generic TeamData ledger and native XP orb. Not a generic setter: full XP level conversion helpers and actual resource debit read. Same task versions not counted again.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: Absent value overwrites constructor1 with0, no disk clamp. Changing points policy can reinterpret previous numeric progress; no automatic conversion. Native arithmetic int overflow outside ordinary range untested; debit/team save not cross-file atomic. No inference old dq progress can be blindly assigned to FTB counters.

semantic_comparators.input: authored saved target(value) and max_input; current team numeric task receipt
semantic_comparators.output: disk target clamped>=1, missing max_input0; actual receive accepts min input/cap/outstanding, simulate leaves receipt unchanged and real call creditsaccepted amount
semantic_comparators.preservation: Concrete physical energy payment objective, different resource debit owner from XP task (external capability vs player XP conversion). Not abstract wrapper alone: actual receive/extract/storage consumers read. Native team persistence shared support0.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: Missing max_input0 means no ingress despite constructor1000: no fallback to constructor. No input negative clamp in handler; caller contract assumed, extract always0. Storage query can dereference missing team and long→inttruncate; full screen binding/cache/capability lifecycle not traced. No native energy transfer runtime or resource conservation claim.

semantic_comparators.input: Object 16hex long目标引用+Radius int；物品自定义名字放置时getID指定目标，红石上升沿执行
semantic_comparators.output: reader parseCodeString空/-/格式异常回0，恢复radius；上升沿附近真实ServerPlayer排假人，目标存在则forceProgressRaw reset=false，实际更新团队started/completed或任务max并markDirty
semantic_comparators.preservation: 独立世界装置持久目标→主动授予任务进度的对象，非TeamData永久真值reader再计；shared底层进度/网络支持0。与一般实体探测器或barrier判权限不同真实业务，载入不直接重发，需新红石边沿；保存POWERED属于blockstate避免把执行缓存当永久用户奖励。
semantic_comparators.application_limit: 缺Radius读0覆盖初值8，负/过大未clamp，目标删除getBase null则无动作且不旁存恢复。update只赋ID未setChanged，放置首次区块保存之外不保证后续修改持久。相同团队多玩家会重复force时间覆盖，不是唯一领奖交易。通知全局临时状态在forceProgressRaw未finally，异常可能留值。具体Reward及ServerQuestFile getID/加载保存调度未全展开，不宣称原生事件/跨死亡实测。

semantic_comparators.input: Object hex任务ID或Stage string；磁盘保存并update→setChanged通知chunk，两个后端同一barrier家族合1
semantic_comparators.output: 新旧player每次碰撞实时查询其team completed或StageProvider.has，授权返回empty shape；client每5tick派生OPEN外观，server不拿视觉OPEN作为权限真值
semantic_comparators.preservation: 存档里的门槛引用和玩家永久权益所有者分开，避免把全root/客户端OPEN复制给新player。Quest/Stage类多数代码同构，特意合并一个门槛恢复owner、不凑2；TeamData和外部Stage状态不是本条新Credit。
semantic_comparators.application_limit: 缺/非法Object回0关闭，空Stage关闭，未知有效ID/Stage没有别名/版本恢复。parseCodeString使用signed parseLong，16hex最高bit值可失败回0，未证实实际ID生成是否排除。任务删除/重建仍按当前ID解析不跟踪旧业务。StageHelper外部provider/FTBAPI获取底层未阅读全文，不声称所有GameStages跨死亡归属已验，当前研究只到consumer和已读TeamData completed。两个Item tooltip无授权检查仅界面提示，不应认为配置修改验证。

semantic_comparators.input: Items原生栈列表、Offers[{Price LONG,Item完整stack NBT}]、Owner UUID、AllowsTransfer、StoredCurrency LONG；两种店铺交易方向。
semantic_comparators.output: 重建报价列表与库存、恢复owner和余额；运行期busy/customer/recipeList/tradeIndex不写；成交更新库存与持久余额。Pawn近同构恢复作为支持变体合并一条。
semantic_comparators.preservation: BE先super+Inventories.readNbt，再ShopOffer.readAll清旧offers逐个fromNbt；fromNbt用完整ItemStack.fromNbt且longPrice传构造，构造拒绝空stack和Price0、却不拒负价；无逐条异常隔离。未知物品变EMPTY或坏报价可中断整次BE读取，后面的Owner/AllowsTransfer/StoredCurrency尚未恢复，不存在原样失效报价隔离。writer写完整stack NBT而非仅ID，所以合法Count/tag被交给原生codec，未知ID能否保留不可假设。Owner只contains而非typedUUID检查，缺Owner不清已有值，新建owner为null；onUse直接owner.equals可出错。管理canPlayerUse明确UUID相等、BE实例在原pos、距离平方<=100；C2S入口仅判当前handler类型，方法不逐次重验canUse，原生handler关闭时序未核。卖店根据canCombine匹配库存求maxUses，成交扣库存并按原买入币栈入账；Pawn方向相反，库存接收买入物并扣储备款，且满仓/余额限制可用次数。两店的NBT恢复几乎逐字段同构，合并为一个家族。持久allowsTransfer控制自动化方向，toggleTransfer本身未markDirty；余额/owner/报价增删会markDirty并调用WorldOps更新。busy、customer及可用trade list重建，不随重载带旧玩家会话。拆除scatter库存和余额币；不是将BE完全拷到新物品。 Master: Shop与Pawn完整恢复/写出/报价/商人/管理入口合并1，持久库存、Owner、报价、StoredCurrency与临时busy/customer分开。未知item/Price0中断整体readAll，reader早先clear后可能部分载入；Owner缺失不清旧值且onUse可能null。成交库存移除计数可能超出实际、货币long窄化int、toggleTransfer缺markDirty，均只作静态风险非运行缺陷判定。Pawn同构不能独立凑数；owner授权handler生命周期/native item codec边界不扩大声明。
semantic_comparators.application_limit: 不把Pawn镜像同构再计1；无native item codec及owo ImplementedInventory/WorldOps完整执行证明。readAll无24项上限（仅管理add时限制），无数据版本/旧ID映射或负数限幅。NumismaticOverhaul.onInitialize静态注册SHOP和PIGGY handler，但未见PAWN_SHOP handler显式Registry.register，故本批不能声称该tag Pawn管理UI已可用；Pawn仅作为同族支持。金额入账/出账和保存非原子，CurrencyHelper.getValue窄化int可能溢出，掉落失败没回滚；实际成交授权/客户端行为未测试。 固定上游源码静态审阅，不直接移植跨版本API，不宣称原生运行验证。未执行上游操作或游戏；固定Numismatic MC1.20.1/CCA5.2.1源码静态研究，不移植平台API或上游死亡惩罚，不等同Dynasty原生验收。

correction_supersedes_input_dedup: Input receipt dedup text incorrectly says Redstone detector reads completion to output power. Accepted f93 is actual redstone-input forceProgressRaw grant. Independent review corrects comparison; does not edit original receipt or ledger.
corrected_dedup: Coordinator actually read13 bounded source ranges before independent peer review; peer independently read13 same pinned ranges, verified hashes and compared accepted TeamData230/ItemTask1a05/energyc1d37/redstonef93/barrier8140/shopb8. One whole placed resource-account binding plus bidirectional partial material redemption. Existing shared counter codec, payment ingress, each field/helper/resource/platform/screen size0. Correct comparator: f93 is active redstone-input forceProgressRaw, not passive completion output; distinction is physical/virtual redemption, not read/write.
limits: This is a resource-account terminal, not a physical inventory snapshot. Item insert returns a copy with count reduced; extract constructs current authored task exemplar, losing actually inserted per-stack NBT. Never use as lossless original-stack escrow or receipt for four Dynasty NBT variants.

load clears task and UV caches but does NOT clear cachedTeamData. Repeated live config load after TeamID change can retain previously cached team; setTeamId does clear it, but config packet invokes load directly. Fresh disk construction differs from reused object.

Item insert and displayed item/fluid/energy progress paths can dereference null team. Unknown task ID resolves null and retries; no unknown definition payload retained. Task cache only checks numeric ID, not replaced quest-file object identity.

TeamData.setProgress returns immediately when locked. Screen item extract returns a newly copied exemplar even if locked debit is ignored; insertion returns reduced remainder even if locked progress credit ignored. No transaction acknowledgment; avoid assuming caller debit/success from request or remainder only.

Item extraction blocks inputOnly, filter templates, completed and unavailable dependencies; fluid drain does NOT check inputOnly. It reconstructs task fluid plus authored NBT, not original offered fluid identity. Negative requested count/input validation is not comprehensive in this wrapper.

Two exposed item slots share team counter, slot1 display empty but extract/insert do not enforce slot domain. Shared progress is persisted in team data; screen stores only owner UUID/taskID/presentation flags, not receipt counter.

saveAdditional compares UUID reference with Util.NIL_UUID, not value equality. Network config permission uses stored team membership/owner and invokes entire load payload; no explicit distance/content whitelist in this handler. Base networking/native validation not fully audited.

ReadDataComponents/native Forge capability registration/BlockEntity disk hooks are source-bound inference, not native runtime acceptance. SNBT.write saveIfChanged result ignored then clears shouldSave; framework SNBT implementation/file IO not audited.

TeamData durability codec and ItemTask matching already independently credited, all subordinate support here0. One complete placed terminal binding/actual reversible virtual resource consumer at most1; no peritem/fluid/energy/UI/screen-size/platform credit.

Additional independent observation: setPlacedBy overwrites TeamID with placing player current team, so copied block-item data does not prove old owner preserved through move/replacement. setTeamId itself does not call setChanged; placement native chunk dirty assumed, not explicitly traced. Config packet later does markChanged.

Negative extract count can make itemsRemoved negative and add positive progress; current wrapper does not locally reject count<=0 or clamp to authored max stack. In normal positive call it returns min(progress,count), not capped to item max stack. Native caller contract and copyStackWithSize behavior unexpanded; no runtime exploitation claim.

Mode-specific extraction check is item path only: fluid drain ignores inputOnly, and drain(FluidStack) checks fluid kind but not requested NBT before delegating. Actual wrapper returns authored task NBT. No lossless escrow claim.

Live reload with new TeamID can retain old cachedTeamData, even though getTeamId reports new UUID and later save writes new UUID. task=null is reset so task resolver changes while team can remain old. Fresh disk load has null cache; distinguish this bug boundary from normal fresh hydration.

Native capability serialization/side authorization and external item/filter matching internals unexpanded; independent exact-range source review, no native acceptance, no Dynasty patch, no new rewards or task ownership changes.
